terra.problem: The text does not say the crowd assumed the Galileans were worse sinners, or that Jesus kept the focus there because the moment was heavy.
Pilate's role as governor of Judea is a fact from outside this passage and needs a reference. 'I'll just say that once and move on' also comments on how Papa tells the passage.
'Worse than anyone else' goes beyond Jesus' question about whether they were more sinful than all the others living in Jerusalem.
'I won't joke about it' comments on how Papa tells the passage.
The parable does not say the man expected fruit or that he left with empty hands.
The explanation is flat and generic in a lighter moment that can hold a real laugh.
The bird joke doesn't follow: finding no fruit on this tree doesn't mean the birds had a quiet year.
The explanation repeats that the tree was not moved, with no personality or laugh in a moment that can hold one.
'The longer word' is inaccurate: 'year' has fewer letters than 'month.'
The drawer comparison doesn't follow. Spending years in a drawer doesn't explain why Papa would think a decade is a lot to ask for the tree.
The parable does not establish that the tree will stay put or that it does not need a fence.
